limitations: Descriptive structural fragility only, neither predictive evidence nor a recommendation to change weights. No backtest or blind/prospective experiment read or modified.
No imputation of historical sectors from present-day information. Missing sector diagnostics explicitly unavailable; concentration of an equal-weight Top-N by company is mechanically 1/N.
Historical ranks were already inspected in earlier research; this is descriptive, not new OOS.
